highlights.title: Show AccuChek & Eversense sensor times
changes: AccuChek sensors now expose start time, serial, warmup end, and expiration time to the app.
Eversense sensors now expose expiration time to the app.
Home screen sensor timers and remaining-time displays use the CGM-reported values for more accurate status.
AccuChek and Eversense data are now included in CGM data gathering so their sensor state is shown in Trio.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1592: Fix: Eversense & Accuchek expires & warming up

highlights.title: Eversense CGM data upload and stability updates
changes: Trio now uploads more diagnostic data to Eversense DMS, including app info, battery history, and glucose-related logs.
Data uploads are more reliable when the app runs in the background.
The app is less likely to crash during state changes.
Bluetooth peripheral handling was cleaned up to help improve connection stability.

includedPullRequests.body: Changelog: - update AccuChek to expose startTime, warming up ends, expires at & sensor serial number - add EversenseKit & AccuChekKit to CGM specific data grabs - small refactor of `resolveSensorExpiresAt` & `resolveWarmupEndsAt` to use switch instead of if-else - cleanup duplicated code inside both functions ### Screenshots AccuChek: Warming up: Expired:

includedPullRequests.title: chore: update EversenseKit
includedPullRequests.body:
Changelog (21 commits from current commit in Trio dev):
- include more data uploads in Eversense DMS
  - Add App info upload (PutAppValues) -> Letting Eversense Support know that the user is on Loop or Trio or iAPS
  - Add Battery upload (PostBatteryLogs) -> Contains the history log of the transmitter's battery for diagnostics
  - Add Essential upload (PostEssentialLogs) -> Contains the glucose log for diagnostics
  - Add Algorithm upload (PostAlgorithmLogs) -> Contains the raw glucose data for diagnostics
- fix data upload while app is in background
- fix app crashes during state changes
- cleanup PeripheralManager
- offline fix (first attempt)
